registers.name: ctrl
registers.description: ASSUMPTION-006: run only after BIST passes; disable forces independent brake. Configuration writes require disabled and idle.

fields.name: soft_rst
fields.description: Write one requests a one-cycle supervisor reset; reads zero.

fields.name: bist_start
fields.description: Write one requests BIST while disabled; reads zero.

registers.name: status
registers.description: Atomic last completed decision status; reset mode L3. No live partial decision exposed.

registers.name: irq_enable
registers.description: Level interrupt mask.

registers.name: irq_status
registers.description: Sticky; hardware set wins simultaneous software clear.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Bits: reject, commit fault, health fault, log overwrite, decision deadline, configuration error, BIST done, decision done.

registers.name: fault_count
registers.description: Saturating count of rejected decisions, once per completed transaction.

registers.name: crc_count
registers.description: Saturating B1 crc rejects.

registers.name: fresh_count
registers.description: Saturating freshness, freeze and clock faults.

registers.name: cert_count
registers.description: Saturating B9 rejects excluding pending/no_pending.

registers.name: health_count
registers.description: Saturating unhealthy transitions.

registers.name: log_lost
registers.description: Golden B10 lost count; saturating; reset clears.

registers.name: last_reason
registers.description: Last decision reason; enumeration in spec ABI.

registers.name: decision_cycles
registers.description: Elapsed clocks of last completed decision.

registers.name: profile_count
registers.description: Config1 locks full 16-profile table; any other value fails configuration.

registers.name: profile_limit
registers.description: Config1 locks maximum 128 integration cells; 129 endpoints permitted.

registers.name: profile_mask
registers.description: All 16 diagnostic profiles enabled. B7 still excludes instant profiles. Config1 locks 0xffff.

registers.name: fresh_timeout_us
registers.description: Config1 locks 150000 us; extension requires golden revalidation.

registers.name: odd_v_max
registers.description: SI times 1000000. Config1 locks 10000000. Hardware field admits up to 20000000 only in a future validated configuration.

registers.name: ack_timeout_us
registers.description: Config1 locks 40000 us.

registers.name: lease_max_us
registers.description: Config1 locks 500000 us from generated.

registers.name: config_valid
registers.description: Zero after reset until defaults checked and BIST complete. Bad write invalidates configuration until defaults restored and BIST rerun.

registers.name: profile_0_decel
registers.description: Fixed Config1 profile 0; deceleration magnitude in SI times S.

registers.name: profile_0_jerk
registers.description: Fixed profile 0; zero denotes instant, excluded by B7.
